This ensures compatibility between clients and servers by specifying
which version of the Model Context Protocol is being used.
Implementations§Source§impl ProtocolVersionSourcepub const V_2026_07_28: SelfSourcepub const V_2025_11_25: SelfSourcepub const V_2025_06_18: SelfSourcepub const V_2025_03_26: SelfSourcepub const V_2024_11_05: SelfSourcepub const LATEST: Self = Self::V_2026_07_28The newest protocol version known to this SDK.
Sourcepub const STANDARD_HEADERS: Self = Self::V_2026_07_28First protocol version that requires SEP-2243 standard HTTP headers.
Sourcepub const NO_INITIALIZE: Self = Self::V_2026_07_28First protocol version that replaced the initialize handshake with
per-request _meta (SEP-2567).
Sourcepub const LATEST_WITH_INITIALIZE: Self = Self::V_2025_11_25The newest protocol version that still has an initialize handshake.
From Self::NO_INITIALIZE onward the lifecycle moved into per-request
_meta, so there is no handshake left to answer. A server replying to
initialize can therefore never name Self::LATEST once LATEST
reaches that revision — it has to name this one instead.
Use this, not LATEST, whenever the subject is the handshake itself:
the version a server can echo from initialize, or the version a test
needs in order to exercise session-based behavior.

assert!(ProtocolVersion::LATEST_WITH_INITIALIZE.has_initialize());
assert!(!ProtocolVersion::LATEST.has_initialize());Sourcepub const KNOWN_VERSIONS: &[Self]All protocol versions known to this SDK, oldest first.
Sourcepub fn as_str(&self) -> &strReturns the string representation of this protocol version.
Sourcepub fn has_initialize(&self) -> boolWhether this revision negotiates its lifecycle over the initialize
handshake.
false from Self::NO_INITIALIZE onward, where SEP-2567 moved the
lifecycle into per-request _meta. Unknown versions are compared
lexically, which orders correctly because every revision is dated
YYYY-MM-DD.

assert!(ProtocolVersion::V_2025_11_25.has_initialize());
assert!(!ProtocolVersion::V_2026_07_28.has_initialize());Sourcepub fn known_up_to(max: &Self) -> &'static [Self]The known versions up to and including max, oldest first.
Servers that implement every revision up to some ceiling can return
this from supported_protocol_versions instead of filtering
Self::KNOWN_VERSIONS by hand. max itself need not be a known
version; the result is empty when it predates all of them.
The result borrows from Self::KNOWN_VERSIONS, so call it directly
in the method body — it needs no static and no LazyLock:

ⓘconst MAX_SUPPORTED: ProtocolVersion = ProtocolVersion::V_2025_11_25;

fn supported_protocol_versions(&self) -> Cow<'static, [ProtocolVersion]> {
    Cow::Borrowed(ProtocolVersion::known_up_to(&MAX_SUPPORTED))
}
assert_eq!(
    ProtocolVersion::known_up_to(&ProtocolVersion::V_2025_06_18),
    &[
        ProtocolVersion::V_2024_11_05,
        ProtocolVersion::V_2025_03_26,
        ProtocolVersion::V_2025_06_18,
    ],
